title: Tax Optimization of the Practice
subtitle: Dr. Soulami & Dr. Marwani are counting on you
synopsis:
Welcome, Doctor! 💰

Dr. Soulami and Dr. Marwani are two talented dentists. Their practices are thriving, but a question haunts them: are they paying too much tax?

Between PIT, CIT, CM, RNR, RNS, CPU... the Moroccan tax system is a real headache.

A wrong choice, and it's thousands of dirhams lost. 💸

Their savings, their investments, their future rest on YOUR shoulders.

chapters.debutant1: Welcome, Doctor! Dr. Soulami and Dr. Marwani are two talented dentists. Their practices are thriving, but a question haunts them: are they paying too much tax? They discover the basics of Moroccan taxation: PIT, CIT, CM, tax regimes.
chapters.debutant2: Dr. Soulami and Dr. Marwani deepen their knowledge of the 2026 Finance Law. They study optimization options, tax reductions, and structural choices for their practice.
chapters.intermediaire1: Dr. Soulami and Dr. Marwani face strategic choices: PIT vs CIT, RNR vs RNS, CPU. They must optimize their taxation to ensure their practice's sustainability.
chapters.intermediaire2: Dr. Soulami and Dr. Marwani manage complex tax situations: depreciation, provisions, VAT, tax audit. They master advanced management tools.
chapters.expert1: Dr. Soulami and Dr. Marwani become tax references for dentists. They train young dentists in optimization and participate in debates on tax reform.
chapters.expert2: After years of practice and commitment, Dr. Soulami and Dr. Marwani pass on their knowledge. They leave a legacy of tax skills and excellence to the dental profession.

chapterEndings.debutant1: Dr. Soulami and Dr. Marwani have laid the foundations of taxation. But the road is still long...
chapterEndings.debutant2: Structural choices are mastered. Dr. Soulami and Dr. Marwani are ready to optimize.
chapterEndings.intermediaire1: Strategic choices are made. Dr. Soulami and Dr. Marwani have gained confidence.
chapterEndings.intermediaire2: Advanced tax management is mastered. Dr. Soulami and Dr. Marwani are ready for greater challenges.
chapterEndings.expert1: Asset optimization has become a key skill. Dr. Soulami and Dr. Marwani train young dentists.
chapterEndings.expert2: Dr. Soulami and Dr. Marwani have accomplished their mission. Taxation is a lever for freedom and success.
